verdict.rationale: Microsoft Entra ID is an identity and access management platform, not an AI agent or assistant that calls tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The only MCP-related evidence (probe-4) describes a Microsoft Learn MCP server, which is the server role and does not make this client axis applicable. Nothing in the pack shows Entra ID itself consuming MCP servers' tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
